title: Check if Arch Linux booted in UEFI or BIOS mode
summary: Determine whether the system booted in UEFI or BIOS mode by checking the firmware bitness. This is crucial for choosing the correct boot loader and partitioning scheme.

aliases.text: how to know if uefi or legacy

prerequisites: Booted into Arch Linux live environment

steps.explain: Read the UEFI firmware bitness file. If it exists and returns 64 or 32, you are in UEFI mode. If it returns 'No such file or directory', you are likely in BIOS/CSM mode.
steps.expect: Output '64' (UEFI 64-bit), '32' (UEFI 32-bit), or an error indicating the file does not exist (BIOS mode).
